name: Social Worker

sections.daily_work: Help individuals and families cope with challenges like mental health, poverty, addiction, and family issues. Connect clients with resources, provide counseling, and advocate for their needs.
sections.learning: Social work degree (BSW or MSW), psychology, counseling techniques, case management, crisis intervention, understanding of social policies and community resources.
sections.pay: Varies by setting and specialization. Entry-level often starts around $35,000-$50,000 USD. Clinical social workers may earn more. Always verify current data for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Bachelor's or Master's in Social Work, field placements and internships, state licensing for clinical practice, volunteering at community organizations.

try_in_real_life: Volunteer at a local shelter, food bank, or community center
Research different social work specialties (school, medical, mental health)
Practice active listening skills with friends and family
Learn about community resources available in your area
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Outlook Handbook (bls.gov/ooh)
